en.apiKeyEnvHint: Name of the key: env var or credential store (default COMFYUI_API_KEY).
en.assetDeleteBody: Removes the record from the asset library and deletes {count} file(s) from the ComfyUI output directory. This cannot be undone.
en.assetDeleteNoDir: The ComfyUI output directory could not be located, so only the record is removed and the files stay on disk (set outputDir in cordis.yml to enable file deletion).
en.assetEmpty: Nothing generated yet. Results appear here after workflows run.
en.cardCollect: Collect the background job result with job_output
en.cardInReply: Results are shown in the reply. Files:
en.cardLoadFailed: failed to load, use the download link below
en.cardPollStalled: Failed to collect the background job status after {n} retries: {message}
en.cardRecovered: Recovered from the asset index (ComfyUI history was evicted)
en.comfyuiDirsHint: ComfyUI install roots on this machine (multiple allowed: mapped/multiple/portable installs). The agent uses them to locate models, workflows and voice libraries.
en.configNotWritable: Settings service unavailable — edit cordis.yml instead.
en.connFailBody: The backend could not reach ComfyUI ({message}). Start the local ComfyUI and make sure the backend can see its port; for a remote server, check the URL in settings and run "Test connection".
en.languageHint: UI language; the page reloads after switching.
en.mediaHostHint: Base URL for media shown in chat (e.g. http://192.168.1.5:3080). Auto-detected when empty; set it if images do not load over LAN or a reverse proxy.
en.noApiKey: No API key configured (usually not needed for local servers)
en.queueError: Cannot read the queue (ComfyUI not running?)
en.settingsDesc: Connect your ComfyUI server so the agent can generate and process images and videos directly.
en.skillBadgeHint: This workflow has a skill pack: the agent reads it before running.
en.skillDeleteWithWorkflow: This workflow has a skill pack. Delete it too?
en.skillDestroyConfirm: ⚠ Permanently delete the whole pack ({count} files) — cannot be undone
en.skillDirtyPrompt: The current file has unsaved changes.
en.skillImageHint: Images are preview-only here; the agent reads one only when the body points at it.
en.skillImportHint: Import local files into the pack: md/txt/json/yaml go to references, scripts to scripts, images/csv to assets (drag onto the list works too).
en.skillIntro: Click "Create skill pack" to add extra skill instructions for this workflow: when to use it, how to fill its parameters, and which pitfalls to avoid.
en.skillNewDirHint: A pack may hold any one-level sub-directory. Common ones: {presets}; custom names work too (letters, digits, CJK, underscore, dash).
en.skillRefreshHint: Re-read the pack directory to show files added or replaced by the agent or the file manager.
en.skillRevealHint: Open this pack folder in the file manager so you can copy files straight in. It opens on the machine running DSH; if you are viewing this page from another machine, use the path shown below instead.
en.skillsDirHint: Directory for workflow skill packs (SKILL.md + reference files). Empty = skills/ under the plugin data dir; an absolute path may target another drive or a synced folder. Existing packs are not moved automatically. Currently in use: {current}
en.skillSummaryHint: The agent uses it to decide whether to read the body — like the description field of a skill.
en.skillSummaryPlaceholder: One line on what this workflow is for
en.transferExportDone: Exported {n} workflows: {names} (the browser is downloading the package)
en.transferExportHint: {total} exportable workflows, {selected} selected. Parameters and skill packs are included.
en.transferPickFile: Click to choose, or drop a .zip preset package here
en.transferPickHint: Import creates new workflows — nothing in your library is overwritten
en.wfComfyuiEmpty: No workflows detected on the ComfyUI server
en.wfComfyuiHint: Auto-detects workflows saved in ComfyUI.nNote: these are UI graphs, not directly runnable — extract them into API workflows, or import an API workflow instead.
en.wfDescPlaceholder: Tells the agent what this workflow does
en.wfEmpty: No workflows detected — create one via New, Import, or Extract.
en.wfExtractEmpty: No extractable components in this graph
en.wfExtractModeAllHint: Merge every component into one runnable workflow (everything executes)
en.wfExtractModeMainHint: Only the largest component (usually the flow under test)
en.wfExtractModeSplitHint: One runnable workflow per independent flow (recommended)
en.wfJson: Workflow JSON (API format exported from the ComfyUI UI)
en.wfJsonError: Workflow JSON could not be parsed
en.wfLoadEmpty: Load area is empty — use "Add slot" below to put media in it
en.wfLoadHint: Click to put media in this slot (slots fill the workflow unset loader parameters in order)
en.wfLoadNoneHint: Empty this slot (the slot stays, with no media)
en.wfLoadSummary: {slots} slot(s) · {loaded} loaded; unset loader parameters take them in order
en.wfNameCopyHint: Click to copy the workflow name
en.wfParamCustomHint: Shown to the user and the agent only; the parameter key is generated automatically. Leave empty for the default
en.wfParamsEmpty: No parameters yet. Click "Detect" to auto-extract prompt / resolution / steps / seed, or "Advanced" to expose any node input manually.
en.wfParamsRecognizeFailed: Detection failed: ComfyUI unreachable or invalid workflow
en.wfPasteHint: Hover here and press Ctrl+V to paste an image/file
en.wfTagAdd: Custom tag, press Enter to add
en.wfUploadHint: Click the preview to pick an image, or paste/upload a new one; the selection becomes the default source for image-to-image
en.wfUploadZone: Drag / Click / Paste to upload into the ComfyUI input dir
en.wfViewEmpty: No executable nodes in this graph
